title: Installations Scheduler (Part-time 20 hours/week · Permanent )
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Installations Scheduler Part-time (20 hours/week) · Permanent · Glasnevin, Dublin 11 (DCU Alpha) At Transpoco, we help commercial vehicle fleets in Ireland, the UK and Europe operate efficiently and safely through our telematics SaaS platform, with live vehicle location data, reports and insights, and solutions for EV transition, carbon reduction and driver safety 🌱 We're the market-leading telematics platform in Ireland, with big ambitions to grow 🚀 We're looking for a highly organised, customer-focused Installations Scheduler to join our Dublin team. Hours are flexible, worked across the week to cover core business days. Why this role? Own the customer's first experience – installation is often the first time customers see Transpoco in action. You'll be their single point of contact from booking to completion. Be the hub of the operation – you'll own the engineers' diaries and turn install, swap and service requests into an efficient daily plan. Help shape how we do it – spot what goes wrong and bring ideas to improve the process. What you'll do Plan and schedule field engineers for installations, swaps, removals and service calls across Ireland and the UK Be the customer's main contact for bookings: dates, vehicle lists, site access and special requirements Get every install completed on the date we promised Confirm stock and devices are ready before each visit Keep the scheduling system and HubSpot accurate and up to date Handle rescheduling, cancellations and same-day changes calmly Chase failed or incomplete visits and escalate recurring blockers Speak up early when a plan isn't realistic, then own it once agreed Report weekly on jobs booked, completed, cancelled and order-to-install lead time Work closely with Sales, Support and the warehouse What you'll bring 1+ years in scheduling, dispatch, logistics or customer-facing coordination (preferred) Clear, confident communication by phone and in writing Strong organisation and attention to detail Calm under pressure and quick to re-plan Comfortable with scheduling tools, spreadsheets and CRM systems Bonus points HubSpot or similar CRM experience Good knowledge of Irish and UK geography An interest in fleet or vehicle technology Why you'll love working here Full training on our platform, hardware and scheduling tools, in a small, friendly team €23,400 per year (pro-rata for 20 hours/week), a permanent contract and company pension On-site at DCU Alpha, Glasnevin – close to the Botanical Gardens and The Gravediggers 🍺

title: Facilities Administrator
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are currently recruiting for a Facilities Administrator to join our Maintenance Team on a contract for a key client. This full-time permanent role (39 hours) will be based in our Head Office, located at Plaza 211, Blanchardstown Corporate Business Park 2, Dublin 15, D15 AP2D. This role would be ideally suited to an individual with a strong administrative background within the Facilities Management or Construction industry as they will provide support and assistance within the department by overseeing the daily operations from job dispatch to completion while providing support and assistance to clients and both the office and management teams. PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES • Managing the scheduling for the department to include scheduling staff and booking client appointments for PPM, general works and renewals of monitoring contracts • Responsible for helpdesk calls – filtering by priority and overall management of same • Liaising with FM Engineers on various queries and providing the necessary follow up and support to resolve any outstanding issues • Assist with the clients account management and co-ordinate the selected framework billing • Assist the Finance Department in dealing with any client queries about their invoices • Following up with clients to obtain PO’s while managing the day-to-day bookkeeping • Liaise with suppliers and act as the point of contact with the Procurement Department • Generate reports to include the monthly review and update of the department guidelines • Provide support to the engineers in their day-to-day duties • Provide quality customer service by dealing with queries from clients and ensuring they are transferred for actioning to the relevant personnel • Liaise directly with your Line Manager in relation to quotations, ensuring same are approved and signed off prior to issue • Manage client queries, ensuring satisfactory customer service is provided to all and queries are escalated quickly and efficiently, where necessary • Manage filing and ensure that documentation is correctly stored SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED • Holds a Business Administration degree or an equivalent qualification or alternatively has extensive administrative experience within a busy commercial environment • Minimum of 2 years’ administration experience in a fast-paced work environment • Experience within the Facilities Management industry is highly desirable • Proficient in Microsoft Office with proven experience of using a variety of software • Excellent analytical ability with exceptional numeracy and data entry skills • Understanding of FM/Building (Mechanical & Electrical) services an advantage

description:

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per azienda cliente leader nel settore impermeabilizzazione di strutture selezioniamo: TECNICO COMMERCIALE AREA EMILIA_AMBITO CIVILE/EDILE Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nella rete commerciale e lavorando a stretto contatto con Area Manager e agenti di zona, sarai un punto di riferimento tecnico per progettisti, imprese e installatori, con un ruolo dinamico tra ufficio e cantiere. In particolare, sarai specialista nel fornire soluzioni tecnico-commerciali presso clientela B2B (studi di progettazione, imprese, installatori e distributori): - supporterai il team commerciale nella definizione della proposta tecnica e tramite sopralluoghi operativi in cantiere - gestirai incontri tecnici e formativi rivolti a progettisti e installatori per diffondere competenze applicative e qualità esecutiva - implementerai nuove relazioni sul territorio e contribuirai all'inserimento delle soluzioni nei capitolati Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - formazione in ambito edile/civile (Ingegneria Edile/Civile, Architettura/Geometra) - esperienza in ruoli tecnico-commerciali nel settore edile (o contesti affini) - dimestichezza con AutoCAD e Office 365 - conoscenza della lingua inglese intermedia - ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, orientamento agli obiettivi e curiosità professionale - disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio (ruolo in mobilità nell'area Emilia Romagna) Orario di lavoro: full time, dal lunedì al venerdì (attività prevalentemente sul territorio con flessibilità operativa e possibilità di smart working). Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto di assunzione diretta a tempo indeterminato per figure middle/senior nel ruolo, mentre con risorse entry level è previsto un apprendistato professionalizzante finalizzato all'indeterminato CCNL applicato: Industria calce, cemento e gesso La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 36.000 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. title: collaudatore di circuiti stampati/collaudatrice di circuiti stampati
description: Sei un giovane Diplomato a cui piacerebbe lavorare in un contesto dinamico e attento alla formazione delle risorse? Questa è l'opportunità giusta per TE! Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico, in partnership con Rotolito SpA, storica azienda italiana che opera nel settore della carta stampata e leader nelle arti grafiche, cerca persone motivate a iniziare un nuovo percorso formativo-lavorativo (IFTS) progettato in collaborazione con l'Istituto Formazione Operatori Aziendali (IFOA) da inserire come ADDETTA/O MANUTENZIONE MACCHINE STAMPA Il ruolo ha lo scopo di prevenire e riparare i guasti dei macchinari tipografici o industriali. Garantisce il corretto funzionamento della linea produttiva, riducendo al minimo i tempi di fermo macchina e assicurando la qualità del prodotto stampato. Di cosa si tratta? Sarai assunto/a con un Contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello, che ti permetterà di acquisire competenze orientate all'innovazione tecnologica in ambito: - Tecnologie dei processi di produzione (Processi grafici, materie prime, macchine, attrezzature); - Controllo qualità del prodotto; - Certificazioni di processo; - Logistica industriale; che verranno certificate attraverso il rilascio di un titolo di studio (Certificato di Specializzazione Tecnica Superiore) subito spendibile nel mercato del lavoro italiano ed europeo. Quali sono i vantaggi di questo percorso? Formazione teorica e pratica fornita da esperti del settore; Opportunità di apprendere e lavorare in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo; Possibilità di assunzione stabile presso l'azienda al completamento del percorso formativo previa valutazione positiva del percorso; La ricerca è rivolta a Candidati/e di età compresa tra 18-24 anni, in possesso di Diploma di Istruzione Secondaria Superiore Superiore o del quarto anno di IeFP di tipo Tecnico. Si offre inserimento con contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello in somministrazione di circa 9 mesi, in partenza a novembre, finalizzato ad una stabilizzazione a lungo termine. CCNL applicato: Grafica Industria Livello di inquadramento: D1 (€1.703, 76 lordi mensili) Retribuzione: Formazione Esterna (300 ore): Non Retribuita Formazione Interna (500 ore): 50% rispetto al Livello di inserimento previsto (€ 4,91 lordi orari) Ore Lavoro (Ca. 200 ore): 70% rispetto al Livello di inserimento previsto (€ 6,88 lordi orari) Luogo di lavoro: Cernusco sul Naviglio (MI) Se sei interessato/a a partecipare a questo percorso presenta la tua candidatura e, in presenza dei requisiti richiesti, sarai ricontattato da un nostro consulente. Cosa aspetti? Non perdere l'opportunità di partecipare al percorso e iniziare a fare la differenza nel settore della grafica! description: Gi Group SpA, prima Agenzia per il Lavoro Italiana ricerca per la propria divisione Gi EDU: FORMATORE / FORMATRICE SENIOR IL RUOLO Il/la professionista si occuperà della formazione dedicata ai DOCENTI di un istituto superiore di secondo grado, avrà la responsabilità di progettare e realizzare il percorso formativo, traducendo gli obiettivi didattici in contenuti, strumenti e attività immediatamente spendibili nella pratica scolastica. Svolgerà le seguenti attività: - Progettazione del percorso formativo in coerenza con gli obiettivi e i bisogni della scuola; - predisposizione dei materiali didattici e delle esercitazioni; - erogazione della formazione in presenza e/o da remoto, secondo il cronoprogramma concordato; - gestione di attività laboratoriali, casi e momenti di confronto con i docenti; - collaborazione al monitoraggio in itinere dell'andamento e degli esiti della formazione. title: tecnico dei macchinari forestali
description: GiPro 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group, prima multinazionale del lavoro italiana, dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per azienda leader a livello mondiale nella produzione, installazione e manutenzione di ascensori, scale e tappeti mobili - GI GROUP SpA seleziona: Tecnico Ascensorista Manutentore/Manutentrice L'opportunità - Lavorare per un'azienda solida, guidata dai valori di sicurezza, stabilità e sviluppo delle persone. - Fare parte di un gruppo che mette al centro la collaborazione e il gioco di squadra e ricoprire un ruolo considerato essenziale dall'azienda. - Lavorare con attrezzatura d'avanguardia e tecnologia digitale che consente la manutenzione di impianti connessi e monitorati da remoto. Il ruolo - Svolgere la manutenzione ordinaria sul parco impianti assegnato. - Rispondere tempestivamente alle chiamate assegnate, essere disponibile per la copertura di chiamate durante l' orario di lavoro e al servizio di reperibilità. - Eseguire ogni tipologia di intervento di manutenzione e riparazione, anche di minore entità. - Relazionarsi con il cliente, all'arrivo e al termine della manutenzione, aggiornandolo circa le condizioni dell'impianto. Il profilo - Esperienza pregressa, anche minima, nel settore, - Preferibile il possesso del diploma ad indirizzo tecnico, - Orientamento al cliente e al risultato, capacità relazionale, flessibilità, spirito d'iniziativa. - Disponibilità alla reperibilità. - Essere in possesso del patentino per la manutenzione ascensori. L'offerta: Inserimento con contratto CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria - livello C3. Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da € 32.000; il pacchetto complessivo potrà essere definito in misura superiore in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze tecniche e del livello di seniority della candidatura. Percorsi strutturati di sviluppo professionale e salary review in funzione di esperienza, performance e competenze maturate. Pacchetto articolato di benefit aziendali e contrattuali, comprensivo di Premio di Risultato, welfare aziendale, Fondo sanitario Metasalute, ticket restaurant da € 10, accordo integrativo di secondo livello, Employee Assistance Program / Programma di Assistenza ai Dipendenti, corsi gratuiti di lingua inglese e iniziative dedicate allo sviluppo delle competenze personali e manageriali. #LI-EP2 Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. description: Our Client is a leading industrial group with a strong manufacturing footprint and established international standards, recognized for operational excellence and a structured, performance-driven culture. To strengthen the Finance function at its manufacturing site in India, we have been retained to search for a: Resident Senior Controller - India The candidate will be responsible for monitoring operational performance of the manufacturing plant in India. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro cliente è una realtà italiana solida e strutturata attiva nelle grandi opere/infrastrutture, con forte presidio su cantieri, impianti e mezzi , che ci ha incaricato di ricercare per la sede di Sondrio un/una SENIOR BUYER - Lavori/Servizi/Forniture | Grandi Opere/Infrastrutture (Sondrio) La risorsa riporterà al Responsabile Ufficio Acquisti e avrà il compito di assicurare l'attività di approvvigionamento di lavori, servizi e forniture in ambito grandi opere e infrastrutture pubbliche, in funzione delle esigenze produttive dei cantieri per la parte plant & equipment. Nello specifico, la risorsa: Gestisce l'albo fornitori: selezione, aggiornamento e proposta di approvazione in linea con procedure interne. Prepara e invia le richieste di offerta, raccoglie le proposte e coordina le verifiche tecniche con le funzioni richiedenti. segue la negoziazione economica e contrattuale (tempi, condizioni, SLA), con attenzione a qualità, lead time e ottimizzazione costi. Desideriamo entrare in contatto con Senior Buyers in possesso di laurea in Ingegneria (Civile, Gestionale, Edile, Meccanica, dei Processi) oppure Diploma di Geometra con esperienza negli acquisti legati ai cantieri, in particolare su impianti e macchinari, materiali, ricambi e servizi (es. manutenzioni) e provenienza da contesti strutturati (ad es società di infrastrutture/costruzioni, EPC contractors, Oil & Gas, aziende produttrici di mezzi di movimentazione/sollevamento). È richiesta la conoscenza della normativa sugli Appalti Pubblici, una buona padronanza del pacchetto Office (soprattutto Excel) e, preferibilmente, familiarità con sistemi ERP (SAP). description: The future of automation needs your hands. And your brain. Do you have a natural passion for mechanics, electronics, and technology? Does the thrill of troubleshooting a fault, solving the issue, and watching an entire industrial plant scale back up to speed get you excited? For a solid, international manufacturing leader in the Food & Beverage / Pharma sectors, with a state-of-the-art facility in Florence (Italy), we are looking for a key player to join the technical team: ELECTROMECHANICAL / ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN Your typical day in the workshop and on the line: You will never get bored. You will be the go-to person to ensure plant efficiency and safety through: Pure Problem Solving: Fast diagnosis and corrective maintenance during breakdowns to get the line running safely again. Strategy: Preventive and predictive maintenance during scheduled shutdowns. Continuous Improvement: Small optimization tweaks on machinery and equipment to make a real difference. Teamwork & Networking: Supporting external technicians during installations and testing, and managing shift handovers. Knowledge Sharing: Providing basic training to line operators (set-ups, format changes, OPL procedures). Organization: Keeping the workshop and spare parts warehouse in perfect order. The ideal profile we are looking for: We want someone eager to learn with a solid technical foundation: Education: Technical diploma (Electrical, Electrotechnical, Mechanical, or Mechatronics). Experience: Already worked in industrial maintenance? Great. If you are a junior profile but have high motivation and a strong technical base, we still want to meet you and invest in your growth. Hard Skills: Ability to read electrical schematics, knowledge of components (sensors, motors, wiring), and a good grasp of mechanics and pneumatics. Soft Skills: Strong teamwork attitude, flexibility, and a result-oriented mindset. Pluses: Basic English and any specific technical certifications are highly valued. What's in it for you (The Offer): Top-tier Environment: Join a well-structured, clean corporate environment equipped with modern technologies. Real Growth: Structured initial onboarding and a continuous technical development path. Solid Contract: Italian 'CCNL Metalmeccanica Industria' (Indicative classification D2 - C2 based on your experience). Competitive Salary: Indicative Gross Annual Salary (RAL) €25,000 - €35,000 + allowances (shifts, on-call, overtime) + company benefits and annual bonuses. Hours and Location: Shift Pattern: Full-time, organized on shifts (06-14 / 14-22 / 08-17). Location: Florence, Italy. Ready to power up your career? title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

description: La Divisione Permanent di Gi Group (Aut. title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

title: responsabile di linea di autotrasporti
description: Project Manager - Cantieri navali Nuove Costruzioni L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è uno storico cantiere navale genovese con un consolidato know how nella riparazione e costruzione navale. Il ruolo Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del business delle nuove costruzioni, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager che segua la realizzazione delle commesse dalla fase di avvio fino alla consegna finale, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi contrattuali, tecnici, economici, temporali e qualitativi. Opererà come principale punto di riferimento verso Direzione, Cliente e funzioni interne, coordinando in modo strategico e gestionale tutte le attività necessarie alla corretta esecuzione del progetto. Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). Gestire la parte economica della commessa: predisposizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast, controllo costi, cash flow, analisi scostamenti e azioni correttive a tutela della marginalità. Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. Gestire la relazione con Cliente/Armatore/Classifica/Autorità: governance, riunioni di avanzamento, comunicazioni e reporting. Governare aspetti contrattuali e tecnici (varianti, change order, extra work, claim) e assicurare commissioning/HAT/prove in mare, chiusura punch list, non conformità e documentazione finale. Il Profilo Ideale Formazione: Laurea in Ingegneria Navale (valutabili Ingegneria Meccanica/Industriale o titoli equivalenti con consolidata esperienza nel settore). Esperienza: - Consolidata esperienza (almeno 8-10 anni) nel ruolo di Project Manager nel settore navale con un focus sulla costruzione navale o in società del settore marittimo. - Preferibile esperienza presso primari cantieri navali internazionali. - Esperienza su commesse di elevato valore economico e complessità tecnica. Competenze tecniche/gestionali: - Conoscenza dei processi e delle fasi di costruzione navale. - Buona conoscenza di strutture navali, impianti di bordo e discipline tecniche. - Capacità di lettura e interpretazione di specifiche tecniche, contratti, disegni costruttivi e documentazione di commessa. Lingue - Ottimo inglese scritto e parlato (seconda lingua preferenziale). Competenze personali - Leadership su team multidisciplinari e forte orientamento al risultato. - Decision making in contesti complessi, pianificazione e gestione priorità. - Flessibilità e disponibilità a trasferte. Cosa offriamo - Inserimento in un contesto industriale dinamico, in sviluppo nel business Nuove Costruzioni Navali. - Ruolo con responsabilità diretta su commesse complesse e strategiche. - CCNL applicabile: CCNL metalmeccanico-industria - Livello di inquadramento: B3/Q - Fascia di RAL da attribuire alla posizione: 60.000€ - 75.000€ - Benefit: mensa, polizza sanitaria e welfare da CCNL. Sede di lavoro: Genova. #LI-GS2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: conduttore di macchine per la trafila di metalli/conduttrice di macchine per la trafila di metalli
description: Hai esperienza come tecnico elettrico? Cerchi una nuova opportunità lavorativa in cui mettere in pratica le tue competenze tecniche? Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico COLLABORA CON C.A.B.I. Cattaneo SPA, azienda che opera dal 1936 a Milano nel campo dei veicoli subacquei e dei sistemi subacquei speciali per la Marina Militare. Progetta, realizza e mantiene in efficienza i prodotti durante l'intero ciclo di vita, gestendone anche l'integrazione con nuovi sistemi per il continuo ammodernamento. Cerchiamo la figura di CABLATORE/MONTATORE ELETTRICO che si occuperà di montaggio, cablaggio, messa a punto e collaudo dei gruppi elettrici ed elettronici dei nostri sistemi subacquei. Quali saranno le tue attività? - Esegue in autonomia i processi di montaggio e cablaggio durante l'allestimento dei gruppi secondo gli standard qualitativi di processo, segnalando eventuali difetti e possibili miglioramenti al proprio responsabile - Mette a punto elettricamente ed elettronicamente i sottogruppi assemblati, ottimizzando l'integrazione ed il funzionamento dei sistemi. - Analizza il guasto di natura elettrica ed elettronica e ripara i gruppi sottoposti a riparazione e/o revisione. - Allestisce banchi prova elettrici ed elettronici per il collaudo dei gruppi assemblati e assiste la conduzione della sala prova su motori termici ed elettrici, secondo specifiche tecniche o istruzioni operative. - Controlla la qualità e conformità dei materiali di acquisto (parte elettrica) e compila la documentazione di competenza di qualità e di produzione. Must have: - Diploma tecnico (perito elettrotecnico, elettronico o indirizzo affine) o formazione equivalente. - Esperienza pregressa in mansione analoga: montaggio e cablaggio di gruppi o quadri, ricerca guasti e riparazione. - Ottima manualità nella saldatura a stagno di componenti elettronici e capacità di eseguire saldature pulite, lucide e prive di difetti - Conoscenza del disegno e delle normative tecniche: lettura di schemi elettrici e distinte di cablaggio. - Disponibilità a brevi trasferte Nice to have: - Qualifica PES/PAV secondo la norma CEI 11-27 per i lavori elettrici (art. 82, D.Lgs. 81/2008). Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

title: Pardavimų vadybininkas - metalo laužas
description:
perkame juodųjų ir spalvotųjų metalų laužą Lietuvoje, parduodame perdirbėjams ir eksportui per Klaipėdą. Ieškome vadybininko, kuris veda sandorį nuo tiekėjo iki pirkėjo ir atsako už jo maržą.
Uždarbis – bazinė dalis ir komisiniai nuo sandorio maržos.

Pirkimo pusė.

Tiekėjų paieška: metalo apdirbimo ir gamybos įmonės, statybos ir demontavimo objektai, laivų
remontas, transporto aikštelės, savivaldybių įmonės.
Objektų apžiūra vietoje: kiek medžiagos, kokios rūšies ir būklės, ar ją reikės pjaustyti, kaip bus
kraunama.
Kainos pasiūlymas pagal medžiagos rūšį ir tos dienos kainoraštį.
Susitarimas dėl konteinerio ar mašinos pastatymo, pakrovimo laiko ir svėrimo vietos.
Atskaitymų už priemaišas derinimas su tiekėju iki pakrovimo.
Pardavimo pusė
Pirkėjų paieška ir derybos Lietuvoje, Baltijos šalyse ir eksporto rinkose.
Partijos komplektavimas iš kelių tiekėjų iki vieno kokybės lygio.
Kainos derinimas pagal tarptautinius indeksus.
Pasiūlymų teikimas su aiškiu galiojimo terminu.
Sandorio vedimas
Eksporto ir atliekų vežimo dokumentai: Annex VII per DIWASS, GPAIS lydraščiai, sąskaitos,
svėrimo pažymos, CMR, eksporto deklaracijos.
Konteinerių užsakymas ir pakrovimo koordinavimas su aikštele bei ekspedicija.
Svorio ir kokybės pretenzijų po iškrovimo sprendimas.
Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.
Regionas
Pasiteisinus pirmiems rezultatams – naujo regiono atidarymas ir jo tiekėjų tinklo formavimas.

title: Teacher French Language B (DP and MYP) (m/f) - 6 months contract
description:
DP (Diploma Programme) and MYP (Middle Years Programme) French Language B - 6 months contract (2627-037)

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

Join Our Learning Community at ISL!

Do you believe that every learner has unique potential, and that education should nurture curiosity, critical thinking, and global awareness? Are you passionate about creating meaningful learning experiences that empower students to make sense of the world and their place in it? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

As a teacher in our school, you will play a key role in shaping not only what our students learn, but how they learn. You'll design engaging, concept-driven lessons that invite curiosity, encourage reflection, and challenge students to connect learning to their own lives — locally and globally. Teaching in our Upper School means that you will be expected to take part in the student wellbeing / advisory programme.
Why ISL?

At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:

· Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
· Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
· Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future

About the Role

At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. We are currently seeking a passionate and reflective French Language B Teacher - Diploma Programme (DP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP)- to join our vibrant learning community in Luxembourg.

As a French Language B Teacher, you will guide students in developing their language acquisition skills and intercultural understanding through the IB DP and MYP frameworks. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for a teacher who sees teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What You'll Do

As our French Language B Teacher, you will:

· Design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences in French Language B across DP and MYP
· Collaborate with colleagues to design interdisciplinary, concept-based, and innovative learning experiences
· Teach and support learners in developing French language acquisition, communication skills, and intercultural understanding
· Create inclusive, differentiated learning environments that support diverse learners
· Foster learner agency, voice, and ownership of learning
· Use assessment and feedback intentionally to guide progress and growth of learners
· Build strong, respectful relationships with learners that promote wellbeing and a sense of belonging
· Using a Learning Management System to organize course materials, support collaboration, and engage students.
· Contributing to the wellbeing and pastoral life of the school, including serving as a student advisor.
· Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
· Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
What will you bring?

Essential:

● Experience teaching IB DP French Language Acquisition and/or MYP French Language B;
● Experience preparing students for IB assessments;
● A recognised teaching qualification and relevant university degree (MA preferred);
● High-level proficiency in French appropriate for teaching Language B;
● Strong skills in inquiry-based, student-centred and differentiated teaching;
● The ability to create inclusive learning experiences for multilingual learners with diverse strengths and needs;
● Strong communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills;
● A reflective, culturally responsive and internationally minded approach to teaching and learning;
● A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and belonging.

Valued Experience:

● Experience preparing students for IGCSE assessments;
● Experience teaching within an international and multilingual school community;
● Experience integrating educational technology and AI thoughtfully into language learning;
● Contributions to advisory, pastoral, co-curricular or beyond-the-classroom programmes.
We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.

We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.

If you are shortlisted, you will receive a notification email to book your interview.

title: Opérateur(trice) de production agroalimentaire (H/F/X)
description:
Description de tâches:

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

CDI – Temps plein – Kleinbettingen (Luxembourg)
Rejoignez un acteur industriel engagé de l'alimentation européenne
Entreprise familiale indépendante fondée au Luxembourg, Les Moulins de Kleinbettingen est un acteur reconnu de la transformation céréalière en Europe.
Depuis onze générations, nous développons un savoir-faire solide dans la fabrication de produits destinés à l'alimentation humaine: farines, semoules, mixes et solutions alimentaires à destination des artisans, industriels et de la grande distribution.

Notre développement repose sur trois piliers essentiels:  qualité – innovation – respect des ressources naturelles

Dans le cadre du développement de nouvelles activités industrielles, nous renforçons nos équipes afin d'accompagner notre croissance et de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence sur l'ensemble de nos lignes de fabrication.

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

Votre mission:

Intégrez une équipe dynamique et participez activement à la fabrication de produits agroalimentaires de qualité.
Sous la responsabilité du Chef d'équipe Production, vous contribuez à la transformation des matières premières en produits finis dans le respect des standards de qualité, d'hygiène, de sécurité et de performance industrielle.
Ce poste vous offre une réelle polyvalence au cœur de l'atelier : vous intervenez sur différentes étapes de la production et pouvez être amené(e) à occuper plusieurs postes selon les besoins. Cette diversité des tâches vous permet de développer vos compétences, de gagner en autonomie et de jouer un rôle clé dans la fluidité de la production.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Production

• Assurer la conduite et la surveillance des équipements d'extrusion.
• Effectuer le suivi des paramètres de production et signaler toute anomalie.
• Veiller au respect des objectifs de production, de qualité et de rendement.
• Réaliser les changements de production selon les procédures établies.

Contrôle qualité

• Effectuer les contrôles horaires des produits en cours de fabrication.
• Réaliser et enregistrer les résultats des contrôles dans le système de gestion de la qualité.
• Prélever des échantillons et effectuer des analyses simples au laboratoire de production:
• Identifier les écarts de qualité et informer la hiérarchie en cas de non-conformité.

Gestion des matières premières

• Assurer le vidage et l'approvisionnement des matières premières nécessaires à la production.
• Contrôler la disponibilité et la conformité des matières utilisées.
• Participer à la gestion des stocks de matières premières selon les procédures en vigueur.

Packaging et préparation de commandes

• Réaliser les opérations de conditionnement et d'emballage des produits finis.
• Vérifier la conformité de l'étiquetage et du conditionnement.
• Préparer les commandes selon les instructions de production et les exigences clients.
• Assurer la traçabilité des produits emballés.

Entretien et nettoyage

• Effectuer le nettoyage régulier des équipements, des postes de travail et des zones de production.
• Respecter les procédures d'hygiène, de sécurité et de nettoyage en vigueur.
• Participer aux opérations de maintenance de premier niveau.

Conditions particulières

• Travail posté selon les besoins de la production.
• Port des équipements de protection individuelle obligatoire.
• Respect strict des procédures qualité, sécurité et hygiène.

Perspectives d'évolution

Ce poste offre une réelle perspective d'évolution vers une fonction de Chef d'équipe Production.
Selon votre engagement, votre maîtrise des équipements et votre capacité à coordonner les activités de production, vous pourrez progressivement évoluer vers un rôle à responsabilités comprenant:

• Encadrement opérationnel d'une équipe de production
• Organisation et suivi des plannings de fabrication
• Coordination des changements de production
• Support technique et organisationnel aux opérateurs
• Contribution active à la performance globale de la ligne

Un accompagnement interne et des formations pourront être proposés afin de soutenir cette évolution.

Compétences requises

• Formation technique, industrielle ou agroalimentaire (ou expérience équivalente)
• Une première expérience en production est un atout, mais non obligatoire
• Vous êtes rigoureux(se), impliqué(e) et appréciez le travail en équipe
• Vous avez le sens des responsabilités et de la qualité
• Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement industriel structuré
• Vous êtes disponible pour travailler en horaires postés
• Vous maîtrisez le français
• L'anglais et/ou l'allemand constitue un avantage

Nous offrons

• Une entreprise familiale solide et reconnue au niveau européen
• Un environnement industriel moderne en pleine évolution
• Un poste concret, formateur et polyvalent
• Une formation complète à nos procédés et équipements
• Une équipe engagée et un management de proximité
• Une véritable opportunité d'évolution vers un poste de Chef d'équipe Production

Intéressé(e)?
Merci d'envoyer votre candidature (CV + lettre de motivation) à:  benoit.gilson@lesmoulins.lu

You will be responsible for implementing the Bank's commercial strategy and risk policy within the Alternative Funds segment, both in Luxembourg and abroad. You will manage and develop profitable client relationships, promote the Institutional Banking Value Proposition, and contribute to the growth of the Alternative Investment Funds business.

Your next challenge:

• Manage and develop a portfolio of clients in the Custodian Banking/Depositary segment and foster long-term relationships through regular client interactions.

• Leverage the expertise available across IB to deliver comprehensive client solutions, drive cross-selling initiatives and identify business growth opportunities in collaboration with the Business Developers.
• Ensure compliance with all applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements, including KYC and AML obligations.
• Oversee the operational follow-up of client requests and instructions, working closely with the Business Office and Compliance teams to ensure service quality and efficiency.
• Contribute to knowledge sharing and training initiatives within Institutional Banking by supporting colleagues and continuously developing specialized expertise.
• Act as an ambassador of the BIL Group through participation in conferences, presentations, training sessions and industry events, while maintaining a strong professional network.
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of products and services for AIF clients through an innovative and client-focused approach.

Your skills:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Audit, Law, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Minimum 5 to 7 years of experience in the banking, fund industry and/or depositary environment.

• Extensive understanding of banking activities, organisational structures, operational risk management processes and control frameworks.

• Proven experience in operational risk assessment, process enhancement and monitoring activities.
• Good understanding of the key drivers and market dynamics of the European fund industry.
• Strong analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.
• Team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a collaborative approach.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of additional languages is considered an asset.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

title: Risk Officer - Vistra Funds Solutions (m/f)
description:
Job Title:  Risk Officer - Vistra Funds Solutions

Job Description:  
It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.  

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction. But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we're absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that
 
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Risk Manager. Reporting to the Managing Director, this full-time and permanent position is based in Luxembourg and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our Operations and its' growth.

Purpose of the Role

The Risk Officer supports the permanent risk management function under the direction of the Conducting Officer and contributes to the effective implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies.

The role involves monitoring investment and operational risks, overseeing risk limits and controls, supporting regulatory and internal reporting obligations, including Annex IV reporting, and ensuring timely escalation of relevant risk matters where appropriate.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal IFM functions and external stakeholders, including valuation, portfolio management delegates, compliance, and oversight functions, to promote effective risk governance and transparent communication across the organisation.

The position requires strong analytical and organisational capabilities, a good command of risk system applications and reporting tools, and a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

The Risk Officer is expected to contribute actively to the continuous development and optimisation of risk processes and controls, demonstrating flexibility, collaboration, and clear communication skills in a dynamic environment. Exposure to UCITS risk management frameworks would be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Risk monitoring for alternative investment funds

• Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies, including risk monitoring, controls, and limit oversight.
• Perform regular risk reporting activities, including contribution to Annex IV reporting, escalation of breaches or anomalies, and maintenance of accurate risk data within risk management systems.
• Contribute to the enhancement of risk management processes, systems, and operational procedures by identifying practical improvements and supporting the implementation of efficient and scalable solutions
• Responsible of the accuracy and timeliness in the production of risk assessment, analysis and reporting including annex IV.
• Perform the monitoring of investment compliance of the AIFs
• Support the development and enhancement of internally developed risk IT tools, including testing of new reporting solutions, data aggregation processes, controls, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the accuracy and reliability of risk analytics and reporting.

Client management

• Serve as a key contact for clients on risk management matters, ensuring appropriate escalation of relevant issues to senior members of the permanent risk management function. Support the delivery of regular client reporting and communication on risk exposures, risk monitoring, and related risk management matters, while responding to client queries in a timely and professional manner.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Liaise effectively with internal IFM functions including portfolio management, valuation, compliance, to ensure consistent risk governance and information flow. Present risk findings and reports to AIF senior management.
  
Attributes/Technical Skills

• Good knowledge of alternative investment fund risk management frameworks for liquid and illiquid strategies.
• Understanding of AIFMD regulatory requirements and Annex IV reporting obligations.
• Experience with risk monitoring tools, limit management systems, and risk reporting applications Knowledge of market, liquidity, counterparty, leverage, and operational risk measurement methodologies.
• Ability to analyse and interpret portfolio risk metrics and exposure reports.
• Familiarity with data aggregation, reconciliation controls, and risk data quality processes
• Exposure to user acceptance testing (UAT) and enhancement of internally developed risk systems and reporting tools
• Good command of Excel and risk reporting tools; knowledge of Power BI, SQL, or data visualisation tools would be an advantage
• Understanding of fund structures, valuation processes, and delegated portfolio management oversight within an IFM/AIFM environment
• Ability to identify control gaps and contribute to process improvement initiatives in a regulated environment.

Relevant Experience

• Minimum 3 year of experience and strong background in similar role managing risk for AIFs
• Demonstrated expertise in risk management system and reporting operations.

Education and Professional Qualification

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or relevant professional certification (e.g., GFR, FRM and CAIA) is a plus

Company Benefits:

• Bonus Plan, based on Group performance and individual performance
• 232 hours of holidays (29 days), plus public holidays;
• Lunch vouchers for the amount of 10.80 EUR (18 per month);
• Additional AXA Health Insurance of which pays 50% (Axa VitalPlus scheme);

• Learning and training, i.e., via our digital learning environment ‘Skills Platform'
• Support for professional qualifications eg ACCA

• Free coffee, tea and fresh fruits in our office
  
It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.  

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
  
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we're absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.

• Actively promote, manage, train, develop and assess all members of the team within assigned area of responsibility.

• Min. 10 years of relevant experience in Private Banking within UHNW Netherlands and other key International client segments.

title: Responsable Administratif et financier RAF (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches


Responsable Administratif et Financier
Rattachement hiérarchique
Direction Générale


Contexte de l'entreprise:

Dans le cadre de la réorganisation opérationnelle et du futur départ de notre actuelle Directrice Administrative d'ici fin 2026, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable Administratif et Financier.

Dans notre environnement d'entreprise multiculturel (allemand, français, luxembourgeois) d'installation et maintenance HVAC, ce poste combine des fonctions de pilotage opérationnel, de contrôle de gestion rigoureux et de supervision transversale.


Missions et Responsabilités Clés:

Le/la RAF aura la responsabilité de superviser les quatre grands piliers de notre administration :

1. Management Général et Opérationnel

Assurer le pilotage de l'organisation administrative globale et le support au quotidien (informatique, événements, parc automobile, matériel).
Manager l'équipe de l'administration : piloter la répartition des tâches, assurer la montée en compétences et gérer les absences et suppléances.
Optimiser et digitaliser les processus internes, résoudre les problématiques inter-services et faire remonter (escalader) les points bloquants à la direction.
Fournir un support opérationnel à la direction générale par la préparation d'analyses, d'évaluations et de bases de décision.

2. Contrôle de Gestion, Finance & Audit

Piloter le contrôle de gestion des projets : analyser les écarts (coûts/recettes/marges), réviser les prévisions, valider les durées de projets et contrôler les coûts post-clôture.
Assurer l'interface entre la finance et le métier : aligner les données de la comptabilité avec la gestion de projet, et suivre les flux de trésorerie (garanties bancaires, retenues de garantie).
Coordonner de manière centrale l'audit financier avec notre auditeur externe (pré-audit de novembre et audit final en mars-avril), préparer les dossiers et justifier les données.

3. Supervision Comptable et RH (en binôme)

Encadrer la facturation régulière et en temps utile des clients.
Organiser les relances et suivre le bon recouvrement des factures clients.
Assurer les cycles de paiement (et la collecte systématique des escomptes fournisseurs).
Procéder au contrôle et à la validation finale des factures d'achat du département administratif.
Superviser l'administration RH : contrôler avec ses équipes les temps de travail avant l'envoi en paie, apporter un support à la rédaction de courriers/contrats RH, et faire l'interface avec le comité d'entreprise.
Fixer les grilles salariales annuelles, notamment pour la facturation des heures de projets.

4. Administration des Systèmes, Gérance Juridique, Services Généraux et Projets Transversaux

Gérer l'administration du système ERP (LABEL) : gérer les accès et les droits, effectuer les clôtures mensuelles et annuelles.
Assurer le suivi des engagements contractuels et la gestion globale des assurances (incluant le traitement des sinistres sur les chantiers et les bâtiments).
Assurer la supervision hiérarchique et le contrôle de la gestion du parc automobile (fleet management).
Piloter la qualité (norme ISO 9001) et mener des projets transversaux d'amélioration continue tels que la poursuite de la digitalisation de l'entreprise.


Profil et Qualités Requises:


Compétences Linguistiques:

En raison de la forte multiculturalité de notre entreprise et des interactions quotidiennes avec les différentes équipes, le profil recherché doit impérativement parler et comprendre l'allemand et le français.
La compréhension du luxembourgeois constitue un atout supplémentaire.


Expertise Technique (Hard Skills):

Solide formation et expérience avérée en gestion financière, contrôle de gestion (idéalement appliqué à la gestion de projets) et comptabilité.
Maîtrise des mécanismes de préparation et de justification lors d'audits financiers (ex. : relation avec des auditeurs).
Expérience dans l'administration des Ressources Humaines et le droit contractuel/gestion des assurances.
Forte aisance informatique avec les systèmes de type ERP (l'administration de logiciels type LABEL est un plus).


Savoir-être et Aptitudes (Soft Skills):

Excellente capacité managériale pour encadrer, coordonner et faire évoluer une équipe variée.
Esprit critique et excellente capacité d'analyse pour évaluer et challenger des données financières et économiques.
Sens aigu de l'organisation garantissant une stricte séparation des rôles entre l'exécution, le contrôle et la validation.
Excellentes compétences de communication inter-départements (capacité à lier les visions comptables, administratives et métier).

title: Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO (m/f)
description:
Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve. We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands, as well as a subsidary in the UK. Supervised by the CSSF we have the ambition to stay true to our purpose to be the most trusted fiduciary of family wealth.

When you join us you are joining a company that values diversity of background, equal access to opportunities, career development, collaboration and inclusiveness. We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

The Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & MLRO has primary responsibility for implementation, oversight and monitoring of the Group's financial crime compliance framework (across money laundering & terrorist financing, sanctions, bribery & corruption, external fraud risks), ensuring robust risk management, full regulatory compliance, and effective detection and reporting of financial crime, thereby safeguarding the integrity, reputation, and resilience of the organisation. The role holder acts as the central point of contact with competent authorities and the FIU on financial crime (including specifically AML/CFT ) matters.

Key Accountabilities

Group AML/CFT Framework Leadership:

• Define, implement and maintain a consistent and effective Group-wide FCC framework aligned with applicable regulations and group risk appetite  across all entities.
• Ensure policies, procedures and control expectations are defined, implemented and maintained.    

Group Financial Crime Risk Stewardship:

• Oversee the effectiveness of the financial crime risk control framework .  
• Provide advice,  guidance and challenge to the 1LoD risk and control ownership.  
• Coordinate and maintain the group-wide financial crime risk assessment.

Client Due Diligence Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of client due diligence and client acceptance processes.
• Ensure higher risk clients are subject to enhanced due diligence.
• Monitor compliance with client onboarding and periodic review requirements.            
                        
Suspicious Activity Reporting Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of transaction monitoring and client/transaction screening arrangements including systems/toolings.
• Act as ultimate escalation point for suspicious activity, investigate complex cases and ensure timely and compliant reporting to FIUs.                                    

Regulatory Engagement & Representation:

• Serve as primary contact for regulators, leading inspections, managing regulatory interactions, overseeing regulatory reporting and ensuring remediation of findings for financial crime matters.                                    

Group MLRO Network & Local Oversight:

• Lead and coordinate local MLROs, ensuring consistent governance, escalation, independence and oversight across jurisdictions.
Governance, Board Reporting & Advisory:
• Provide regular FCC reporting to senior management and the Board, advising on risk exposure, control effectiveness and mitigation strategies.
• Ensure escalation of major financial crime risk events, breaches or control issues, ensuring appropriate reporting, documentation and remediation.

Culture, Training & Awareness:

• Promote a strong compliance culture throughout the organisation by designing and delivering effective AML/CFT training and awareness across all levels of the organisation

Knowledge and Experience

title: Lower School Learner Support Teacher - 1 year contract (m/f)
description:
Want to help every learner access, participate and thrive?

At the International School of Luxembourg (ISL), we believe that learner diversity enriches our community. We are looking for a Lower School Learner Support Services (LSS) Teacher who is passionate about creating inclusive learning environments where children feel known, valued and empowered to grow.
Working within our learning community, you will support students with language acquisition and/or diverse learning needs, partnering closely with classroom teachers, families and colleagues across Learner Support Services. Through responsive teaching, targeted intervention and inclusive practice, you will help remove barriers to learning and enable students to develop confidence, agency and independence.
Why does this Role matter?
You will be an important advocate for learners and a resource for our whole learning community. Your expertise will help teachers respond to learner variability, help families understand and support their child's development, and—most importantly—help students recognise themselves as capable, active and successful learners. At ISL, learner support is not simply about helping students overcome challenges. It is about creating the conditions in which every child can participate, develop agency, experience success and reach their potential.

Why ISL?
At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:
● Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
● Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
● Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future
At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for teachers who see teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What will You do?
● Support learners individually, in small groups and within the classroom through inclusive, evidence-informed language and learning interventions.
● Co-teach and collaborate with classroom teachers to differentiate learning experiences and ensure meaningful access to the IB Primary Years Programme curriculum.
● Build learner agency by involving students in understanding their strengths, setting learning goals and reflecting on their progress.
● Use assessment purposefully to identify learning needs, monitor growth and adapt interventions and support.
● Develop and monitor Individual Learning Plans, accommodations and targeted learning goals for students requiring additional support.
● Case-manage students receiving language or learning support, maintaining clear records and coordinating communication between students, families, teachers and relevant specialists.
● Partner with families, building trusting and respectful relationships around each child's learning, development and wellbeing.
● Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, including classroom teachers, counsellors, school leaders and external specialists.
● Strengthen inclusive practice by sharing expertise, resources and strategies with teachers and teaching assistants.
● Contribute actively to the wider Learner Support Services Team and our collaborative professional learning culture.
● Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
● Engaging in personal professional growth and bring fresh ideas into the classroom.
● Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
You will thrive here if you …
● Build positive, trusting relationships with children and creates a strong sense of belonging and psychological safety.
● See learner variability through a strengths-based and inclusive lens.
● Differentiate learning thoughtfully and creatively to reduce barriers and increase participation.
● Collaborate effectively and sees co-teaching as a shared professional practice.
● Communicate sensitively and clearly with students, families, colleagues and external specialists.
● Use evidence, observation and assessment to make informed decisions about learning.
● Are organised and dependable when managing individual learning plans, referrals, documentation and confidential information.
● Reflect on your practice, seeks feedback and remains curious about developments in language acquisition and inclusive education.
● Demonstrate cultural responsiveness, empathy and respect within a diverse international community.

Who are You?
● Strong knowledge of inclusive education, learning differences and/or English language acquisition.
● An understanding of multi-tiered systems of support (“MTSS”) and the use of targeted, evidence-informed interventions.
● Experience with co-teaching, differentiation and inclusive classroom practice.
● Able to use assessment information to identify needs, establish goals and monitor student progress.
● Hold a current teaching qualification/certification and a Bachelor's degree or equivalent; a Master's degree in Special/Inclusive Education, Learning Support, Learning Differences or Language Acquisition is highly valued.
● Preferably two years of recent successful experience working with preschool or primary-aged learners with language and/or learning support needs.
● Experience supporting multilingual learners and recognising multilingualism as an asset.
● Experience interpreting psychoeducational assessments and translating recommendations into classroom practice would be an advantage.
● Experience in an international school and/or IB PYP environment is highly valued.
● Near-native fluency in English and confidence using digital tools to support learning, collaboration and documentation.

We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.
We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.

title: AML Governance Officer (m/f)
description:
AML Governance Officer

Location Leudelange
Experience Level Experienced
Home Office Yes, partially possible

Your Job in a Nutshell

The AML Governance Officer is responsible for strengthening and harmonising AML/CFT governance across our EU entities and branches. Working closely with the Group AML/CTF Office in Switzerland and local Compliance teams, you will support the Group-wide AML/CFT Compliance Function, oversee key AML/CFT risks and regulatory developments, and help ensure consistent and effective compliance across Europe.

What you can expect

• Develop, maintain and continuously enhance the EU AML/CFT Governance Framework, ensuring consistent implementation of policies, standards and controls across EU entities.
• Monitor EU and international AML/CFT regulatory developments, assess their impact and coordinate the implementation of new requirements across the organisation.
• Coordinate and provide oversight of the EU-wide ML/TF Risk Assessment, challenging local assessments and ensuring that identified risks are appropriately addressed.
• Act as a key contact for AMLA and other supervisory authorities, coordinating regulatory requests, inspections, submissions and remediation actions.
• Support the EU AML Compliance Manager and Group AML/CTF Office with governance reporting, regulatory analysis, risk monitoring and preparation of management and committee materials.
• Coordinate with local AML Officers and Compliance teams to promote consistent standards, effective information sharing and best practices across jurisdictions.
• Monitor the effectiveness of the AML/CFT governance framework, identify areas for improvement and support audits, regulatory reviews, remediation programmes and training initiatives.
• Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across Compliance, Legal, Risk, Audit and the business to foster a strong AML/CFT governance and compliance culture.

What we expect

• Master's degree in Law, Compliance, Finance, Risk Management or a related field. An AML certification (ACAMS, ICA or equivalent) is an asset.
• 10+ years of experience in AML/CFT, ideally within insurance, banking or financial services, with international exposure.
• Strong knowledge of the EU AML/CFT regulatory framework, including AMLA requirements, EU AML legislation, FATF standards and EBA guidelines.
• Proven experience working with regulators and supervisory authorities.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organisational and reporting skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative and adaptable mindset.
• Very good command of English and French, both written and spoken. Any additional language is an asset.

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe.
